brief:
A 72-year-old Palestinian woman, Fadha Wadha, was shot dead in an overnight attack by Israeli settlers outside her home in al-Duyuk al-Tahta village near Jericho, according to residents and The Guardian. A bullet struck her in the head during the attack.

The incident occurred in an area where settlers have a history of confrontations with Palestinians. The killing adds to a pattern of violence in the West Bank village.

title: Israeli settlers shoot Palestinian woman dead near Jericho
